cache_policy: Before each pair, read/hash original DB3 completely. Warm-disk comparison, not cold-disk or target-hardware acceptance.
quiet_policy: No full gates, raw detector replays, builds or archive compression during ROS captures; allow 30 seconds after competing work to settle.
checker: Same dry_run.sh/check_dry_run.py for both; host python shim uses declared resense-cycle-dev dependencies.
freshness: Existing contract plus separate strict fresh-current per-target coverage; do not equate processed frame count with usable results.
limitations: Single paired local sequences are scoped to this host and workload; failures retained. Timing_ms.total still excludes health, so full node metrics are used.
